description: This file defines an abstract base class for MQTT protocol adapters based on Vert.x within the Eclipse Hono project. It implements core MQTT connection handling, authorization, message forwarding, subscription management, and command processing for the Hono IoT platform, allowing subclasses to implement specific payload processing and downstream messaging.

classes.name: AbstractVertxBasedMqttProtocolAdapter
classes.description: A generic base class for Vert.x-based MQTT protocol adapters in Hono, managing MQTT server lifecycle, authentication, connection handling, message forwarding, and subscription management. Subclasses implement application-specific payload processing.

methods.name: setAuthHandler
methods.description: Sets the authentication handler used for authenticating devices.

methods.name: setTenantObjectWithAuthIdProvider
methods.description: Sets the provider to determine tenant and auth ID from a request context.

methods.name: getPortDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default port number for MQTT connections (1883).

methods.name: getInsecurePortDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default insecure port number (1883).

methods.name: getActualPort
methods.description: Returns the port the MQTT server is listening on if started, else a constant indicating unconfigured.

methods.name: getActualInsecurePort
methods.description: Returns the insecure port the MQTT server is listening on if started, else a constant indicating unconfigured.

methods.name: setMetrics
methods.description: Sets the metrics implementation used for monitoring.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves the metrics implementation.

methods.name: createAuthHandler
methods.description: Creates the default chain authentication handler combining X.509 and username-password handlers.

methods.name: createTenantAndAuthIdProvider
methods.description: Creates the provider for tenant and auth ID extraction from MQTT contexts.

methods.name: setMqttSecureServer
methods.description: Sets the MQTT server instance handling secure connections.

methods.name: setMqttInsecureServer
methods.description: Sets the MQTT server instance handling insecure connections.

methods.name: bindSecureMqttServer
methods.description: Binds and starts the MQTT server for secure connections based on configuration.

methods.name: bindInsecureMqttServer
methods.description: Binds and starts the MQTT server for insecure connections.

methods.name: bindMqttServer
methods.description: Creates and starts an MQTT server with specified options, handling endpoint connections.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Initializes and starts the MQTT server(s), sets up authentication, and connection limiting.

methods.name: doStop
methods.description: Gracefully stops the MQTT server(s), closing connections.

methods.name: handleEndpointConnection
methods.description: Handles a new MQTT client connection, including authentication and session setup.

methods.name: handleConnectionRequest
methods.description: Processes a connection request, respecting connection limits and authentication requirements.

methods.name: handleConnectionRequestResult
methods.description: Handles the result of device authentication for connection requests, accepting or rejecting clients.

methods.name: handleEndpointConnectionWithoutAuthentication
methods.description: Handles clients connecting without authentication, registering handlers for messages.

methods.name: handleEndpointConnectionWithAuthentication
methods.description: Handles authenticating a client connection, including tenant/device auth, authorization, and handler registration.

methods.name: applyTenantTraceSamplingPriority
methods.description: Applies trace sampling priority from tenant context to the current span.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs device authentication via the configured auth handler.

methods.name: onSubscribe
methods.description: Manages device subscription requests for command topics, creating consumers and acknowledging.

methods.name: isGatewayMappingEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether gateway mapping is enabled for commands; always true here.

methods.name: newSpan
methods.description: Creates a new tracing span for a given operation, tagging with connection and auth info.

methods.name: onUnsubscribe
methods.description: Handles device unsubscribe requests for command topics, removing subscriptions.

methods.name: createCommandConsumer
methods.description: Creates a command consumer for a device to handle incoming commands.

methods.name: handlePublishedMessage
methods.description: Processes an incoming MQTT published message, including tracing, authorization, content checks, and forwarding.

methods.name: checkTopic
methods.description: Validates the message topic, failing if malformed.

methods.name: uploadMessage
methods.description: Routes the message to telemetry, event, or command response forwarding based on endpoint type.

methods.name: uploadTelemetryMessage
methods.description: Forwards telemetry data downstream, including tenant configuration and metrics.

methods.name: uploadEventMessage
methods.description: Forwards event data downstream, including tenant configuration and metrics.

methods.name: uploadCommandResponseMessage
methods.description: Handles forwarding of command response messages, including status code parsing, tracing, and metrics.

methods.name: uploadMessage (overload)
methods.description: Helper for forwarding a message with tenant info, payload, and downstream sender.

methods.name: uploadTelemetryMessage (helper)
methods.description: Helper for forwarding telemetry data with tenant configuration.

methods.name: uploadEventMessage (helper)
methods.description: Helper for forwarding event data with tenant configuration.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes client connection, cancels subscriptions, and records disconnect metrics.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to handle resource cleanup on connection close.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Extracts credentials from the MQTT CONNECT packet, typically username and password.

methods.name: onPublishedMessage
methods.description: Abstract method to process an MQTT message published by a device; subclasses must implement.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamMessage
methods.description: Allows subclasses to modify the downstream message before sending.

methods.name: onMessageSent
methods.description: Hook invoked after successful downstream message delivery.

methods.name: onMessageUndeliverable
methods.description: Hook invoked if downstream delivery fails, for metrics or error handling.

methods.name: onCommandReceived
methods.description: Called when a command message should be delivered to a device; to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: onMessageUndeliverable
methods.description: Hook for handling undeliverable messages; empty default implementation.

methods.name: onCommandReceived
methods.description: Handles a command delivery to a device, constructing topic, logging, publishing message, and handling acknowledgment or errors.

methods.name: getTimeToLive
methods.description: Extracts the time-to-live duration from a property bag; returns null if invalid or not present.

methods.name: afterCommandPublished
methods.description: Performs logging and metrics reporting after a command message has been published successfully.

methods.name: addRetainAnnotation
methods.description: Adds annotation to message span if the message retains a value.

methods.name: createLinks
methods.description: Creates downstream sender links for telemetry and event channels, logging success.

methods.name: registerHandlers
methods.description: Registers MQTT endpoint handlers for publish, subscribe, unsubscribe, close, and acknowledgments, initializes connection metrics.

methods.name: getConnectReturnCode
methods.description: Maps exceptions during connection to corresponding MQTT connect return codes.
